## Summary

Fix the `--exclude` default so CI jobs can configure exclusions through `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches file names, skips matching files, and logs skips in verbose mode. It also documents the flag and adds tests for argument parsing, file collection, and archive contents.
